description: Execution-planning metadata for ShopSphere's test catalog: SYNTHETIC planning-only duration estimates (never measured/observed run times -- see disclaimer), serial/parallel execution-phase prerequisites, and one optional infeasible-budget scenario for negative evaluation of a selection agent's constraint handling. Do not confuse any field here with docs/architecture.md's 'measured' local run output or /fullstack-evaluator/tdd-evidence.md.
disclaimer: All *_synthetic_planning_estimate_seconds values below are FABRICATED for planning-capability evaluation only. Real local runs are two to three orders of magnitude faster (see README.md's actual `npx playwright test` output, on the order of a few seconds for the whole suite). Never present these numbers as measured.

execution_phases.name: mandatory-smoke
execution_phases.note: Health smoke runs first, serially, as a fail-fast gate before spending time on anything else.

execution_phases.name: backend-and-frontend-regression
execution_phases.note: Parallel-safe: backend API tests carry no shared mutable state (profile tests use unique ids per test, see REQ-PROFILE-001), and UI tests each navigate fresh page instances.

execution_phases.name: critical-journey-and-accessibility
execution_phases.note: Run serially in constrained CI runners as a synthetic planning precaution against shared-Chromium-worker resource contention on the mandatory/protected journey; not required by the tests themselves, which are independently parallel-safe.

execution_phases.name: metadata-integrity
execution_phases.note: Runs last: verifies the catalog against the full Playwright collection produced by the earlier phases' code changes.

constraint_scenarios.purpose: Negative-evaluation fixture: an infeasible budget where the mandatory+critical protected tests alone (per test-metadata/critical-journeys.json's protected_test_ids) exceed the stated ceiling using the SYNTHETIC estimates above. A correct selection agent must surface this conflict explicitly rather than silently truncating protected coverage to fit the budget.
constraint_scenarios.expected_agent_behavior: Report that the 6-minute (360s) budget cannot accommodate the four protected/mandatory tests' synthetic estimate (540s) and either ask for a relaxed budget or explicitly recommend running the protected set anyway with the overage flagged -- never silently drop a protected test to fit the window, and never present the synthetic estimate as a measured guarantee.
